sloka: इमाम् अभिगमिष्यामि न हि इयम् विचिता मया ।वसून् रुद्रामः तथा आदित्यान् अश्विनौ मरुतो अपि च ॥५-१३-५६॥
transliteration: imām abhigamiṣyāmi na hi iyam vicitā mayā ।vasūn rudrāmaḥ tathā ādityān aśvinau maruto api ca ॥5-13-56॥

translations.english: "I shall offer salutations to Vasus, Rudras Adityas and Aswinis and proceed to increase (cause) the sorrow of the demons. (There are eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas, two Ashwins and fortynine Windgods).
